description:
The two family producing-input closures of the mid-range buffer study enumerate the source tree, and a merge that adds or removes an enumerated source file invalidates them without any CI step noticing; the CI contract checks them.

## Background

`make-dense-producing-inputs.py` and `make-logical-producing-inputs.py`, under `dev/active/2037941f-profile-and-optimize-mid-range-buffer-operations/survey/`, write `dense-producing-inputs.json` and `logical-producing-inputs.json` beside them. Each has a `--check` mode that writes nothing and exits non-zero when the committed closure differs from the tree. `scripts/cargo-ci.sh` runs `dev/scripts/check-campaign-producing-closure.py`, which checks the shared closure only and leaves a family closure to its generator's `--check`. No CI step runs either generator's check.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `./scripts/cargo-ci.sh` fails when either family closure differs from the tree, shown by a test that adds a source file to an enumerated directory.
- [hard] REQ-02: Both checks pass on the committed tree; the added CI work compiles nothing and writes nothing inside the repository.
- [hard] REQ-03: The CI script reaches the closures through the repository's shared file locator, with no literal development-artifact path.

## Notes

Found when merges that added source files left both closures stale.
